d:
The month is ending, but not before enjoying the latest chapter of a main story! Our fairies and agents return and plan their next move to stop the corrupt Blum... It seems a library holds the key, however, what they don't know is that Blum will go to the same library, but with a different objective. What will happen? It's time to find out!
